title: Grateful Dead Live at Bellarmine College on 1968-12-07

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording captures a rare Rosemary performance and a soaring Dark Star jam, delivering a high‑energy late‑'68 show with solid audio quality.
ai_review.review: The set is highlighted by an unusually quiet but unique live rendition of "Rosemary" and an expansive Dark Star > Stephen > 11‑Jam > Death Don't sequence that showcases the band's improvisational peak. Reviewers note the soundboard source is surprisingly clear for 1968, letting Garcia's blistering guitar work and occasional organ and drum cues shine through despite a few early‑night sound hiccups.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive reviews (average 4.25★) praise both the musical performance and the decent soundboard recording, with only minor comments about early‑set sound issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear enough to hear individual instruments; Garcia's guitar is prominent, occasional organ and drums are audible. Reviewers call it "pretty good for '68" with no major drop‑outs.

standout_songs: Dark Star > Stephen > 11 Jam > Death Don't
show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert starts a bit tentative due to early sound problems, then builds into relaxed yet adventurous jamming—culminating in an extended Dark Star/Other One segment that feels like the band was freely cutting loose.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar work is highlighted as blistering and clearly heard throughout; his lead vocals are also praised.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass (and occasional organ) can be picked up in the mix, though not a focal point.
band_member_comments.Keys: Organ/keyboard moments are audible occasionally, adding texture to the jams.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drummers are heard enough to support the improvisations, noted as part of the overall mellow vibe.
